role: The recipe registry: builds every vanilla recipe at class load (shaped, shapeless and the special recipe classes), sorts them by shapeless-first and size, and finds the match for a crafting grid.

members.name: instance
members.note: a singleton; the native holds the tables at file scope

members.name: recipes
members.note: 317 baked recipes in the sorted order, with the special classes as recipe kinds

members.name: CraftingManager
members.note: every addRecipe/addShapelessRecipe call and the Recipes* classes' addRecipes ran at bake time; the shapeless-first size sort is baked into the order

members.name: addRecipe
members.note: the bake-time builder: the pattern string, the character map (Item, Block as wildcard 32767, ItemStack) and the grid

members.name: addShapelessRecipe
members.note: the bake-time builder of the ingredient list

members.name: findMatchingRecipe
members.note: the two-stack repair path first (crafting.c:repair_result), then RECIPES in list order, first match wins; the five code-matched special classes are in the same switch

notes: The recipes.h table was generated from the oracle (the comments carry the original ItemStack toString), so registration drift would show in test_crafting.c and test_registry.c.
